sn29.7:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn29.7:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 4
sn29.7:2.1: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti vācāya dvayakārī hoti manasā dvayakārī hoti ||
sn29.7:2.3: Aṇḍajā nāgā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā ti || || 5
sn29.7:2.5: Ahovatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānam sahavyataṃ upapajjeyyanti || || 6
sn29.7:2.6: So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjati || || 7
sn29.7:2.7: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti || || 1-2
